items.summary: Inter secured their first Champions League win of the season with a hard-fought 1-0 victory over Shakhtar Donetsk at San Siro, with Carlos Augusto netting the winner in the 77th minute despite playing with ten men after Alessandro Bastoni was sent off.

source.title: Inter 1-0 Shakhtar Donetsk: Augusto ends winless European run despite Bastoni red

items.summary: Bastoni will miss Inter's next Champions League fixture against Feyenoord after receiving two yellow cards within just two minutes and 18 seconds, becoming the first Inter player to be sent off in the competition since Alexis Sanchez in March 2022.

source.title: Inter 1-0 Shakhtar Donetsk: Augusto ends winless European run despite Bastoni red

items.summary: Despite their European struggles earlier this season, Inter remain dominant in Serie A, sitting top of the table with 19 points from seven matches after bouncing back from their Champions League defeat to Club Brugge with a 3-1 win over Bologna.

source.title: Kolarov: Inter have nothing to prove to anyone
